title: Refusal contract: MIME-type, size-limit and virus-scan refusals with an aria-describedby error binding and focus-to-retry
description: The upload surface refuses a file that fails the MIME-type gate, exceeds the per-file size cap, or matches the virus-scan hit. Every refusal renders a per-file error message inside a region bound to the file row via aria-describedby, moves keyboard focus to the row's retry control, and refuses to send the file to the server. The refusal reason is one of the closed strings mime-refused, size-refused, virus-refused so a project's log pipeline can classify without prose parsing.
rationale: Per the application-core specification section 5.2, REQ 3.
